title: AC1021 VIEWPORT clip-boundary role compatibility
scope: Resolve a source-specific parser regression in the selected AC1021 colorwh VIEWPORT profile while preserving the ODA-specified role and strict role checks in other versions and fields.

authority.conflictDisposition: Do not change the specification mapping. Permit a version-scoped parser compatibility case for the two observed AC1021 source handles only at this field; all other VIEWPORT handle roles remain strict.
authority.authorityLimit: The ODA field role does not establish how AutoCAD or other native consumers interpret this sample's nonconforming hard-pointer encoding.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; producer and author are unauthenticated. No source or derivative is committed.
source.observationMethod: The production parse first rejects each raw code 5 as the ODA-required soft pointer, then enters the AC1021-only hard-pointer compatibility branch. The debug trace contains exactly two compatibility markers for this source.

implementation.change: After a failed soft-pointer role check for the AC1021 clip-boundary field only, retry as a hard pointer. Keep every other version and VIEWPORT link role unchanged. Add a complete AC1021 frame generated by the in-tree writer; the fast test checks normal soft-pointer parse, mutates the unique clip handle code from 4 to 5, and checks identity and target preservation.
